messages:
Tara: Quick follow-up from the PM: we need a compact action plan for the KV-residency/frag OOM postmortem. Who can own profiling artifacts and a short remediation timeline?
Miguel: I can take profiling + baseline pprof exports. Will produce heap+alloc traces and shard residency heatmaps. Target: 48h for first pass. :calendar:
Priya: I can own GC/limit tuning and can spearhead a canary with soft-limit guardrails. 72h to a canary plan + rollout playbook.
Sam: We should add a smoke test that simulates the typical request fanout that triggered the OOM. I have a small harness we can reuse.
Linus: Repro notes I saved during the incident: single-request with 16 concurrent sessions hitting 512-step context on alpha shards caused rapid residency growth. Minimal repro script: 
```
# repro.sh
for i in `seq 1 16`; do
  curl -s "https://alpha-infer.internal/api/gen?ctx=512" &
done
wait
```
This reproduces the residency spike locally on a dev instance.
Miguel: for artifact collection, run pprof and shard exporter: 
```
./bin/runtime profile --out=/tmp/pprof-kv.pb --type=heap
shard-exporter --target=shard-*/metrics --out=/tmp/shard-heat.json
```
Upload to S3://redwood-incidents/pm-3891234567/
Priya: GC knobs I want to try: increase frag-gc frequency, reduce soft-residency threshold by 15%, and enable staggered eviction windows. I’ll write the config diffs.
Tara: Ownership: Miguel = profiling artifacts + archetype reports, Priya = GC & limit proposals + canary plan, Sam = smoke test + CI gating. Linus = repro verification + ops runbook update. I’ll coordinate stakeholders and set weekly check-ins.
Sam: For the smoke test I’ll add a latency/assertion that checks for KV-residency growth > 1.2x baseline and fail the job. Pseudocode: 
```
start_load(16, ctx=512)
wait 60s
assert(residency() < baseline*1.2)
```
Miguel: I'll drop the first artifact bundle by EOD: pprof + allocations + trace. Expect tarball link in thread.
Priya: Can we add a short-term mitigation? My suggestion: apply a soft limit on alpha shards and route overflow to a lower-residency pool while we tune. That would require a routing flag and an emergency policy in the console.
Tara: Agreed — put the routing-flag RFC in a PR and tag @infra-eng for fast review. Add a one-liner runbook for rollback.
Linus: Note: we saw a fragmentation signature in the core dump: many small allocations pinned by long-lived KV refs. That points to residency churn rather than allocator bug.
Priya: Good to know — I'll prioritize eviction policy + reference lifetime checks.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary-soft-limit-v1 -> staging at 2026-03-12T22:00Z. Triggered by Priya.
Tara: Next steps and timeline summary: Miguel (48h) artifacts -> link + short report; Priya (72h) GC+limits PR + canary; Sam (5d) smoke tests + CI gate; Linus (48h) repro confirmation + runbook. Weekly check-in Thu 10am.
Miguel: Received. Will include step-by-step how to reproduce the profile locally in the artifact README.
Sam: I'll stub the CI job today and push a branch for review.
Priya: I'll open the GC/limit PR tomorrow morning and add a small perf test.
Tara: Thanks — please add any blockers here. Also add small checklist items: upload artifacts, create canary runbook, stage rollback steps, schedule on-call handoff for the canary window.
Linus: One small blocker: need permissions to the incident S3 bucket (S3://redwood-incidents/pm-3891234567). @ops can you grant Miguel & Linus write?
Tara: @ops assigning this now.
Priya: FYI, after tuning we should schedule a follow-up eval against the production prompt corpus to ensure quality didn't regress. I'll coordinate with Eval team.
Miguel: Artifact upload done: s3://redwood-incidents/pm-3891234567/profiles.tar.gz :link: -- includes pprof, shard heatmaps, and brief notes.
Sam: CI smoke job draft pushed: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/-/merge_requests/1284 :eyes:
Tara: Great progress. I'll post a recap to #incidents and add calendar invites for the Thu check-ins.
Linus: Verified repro on a small infra node and confirmed residency spike. Pushed a small gist with exact curl sequence.
Tara: Closing loop: owners and timelines confirmed. We’ll keep this thread for status updates. If anything changes ping me directly. :thumbsup:
notes: Postmortem follow-ups and action item thread focused on KV cache residency, fragmentation, GC tuning, soft limits, profiling artifacts, smoke tests, and canary rollout. Short, ops-oriented messages with commands and links.
